name: Brilliant Rapier

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

text: This +2 brilliant greater striking rapier is formed entirely out of radiant energy, even more so than a usual brilliant weapon, and has left its physical form behind entirely. Instead of dealing piercing damage, it deals fire damage, and in addition to a rapier's normal weapon traits, it gains the versatile spirit or vitality trait.
